subject: dutchWindmill
pitch:
Category: Architecture.
Subject: Dutch windmill.
Style: Animal Crossing.

requests.what: Paint the cream tower with a charming hand-laid Dutch brick and stone pattern: warm STONE_LIGHT blocks, irregular MORTAR seams, slightly darker STONE blocks near the base, and a few subtle worn patches. Keep the pattern chunky and readable in the Animal Crossing style.

Add overlapping rows of broad red ROOF shingles to the conical cap, with alternating ROOF_LIGHT and ROOF_DARK bands, a darker underside at the eaves, and soft painterly variation rather than tiny realistic tiles.

Texture the four wooden sail frames with warm WOOD and WOOD_LIGHT grain, darker WOOD_DARK edges, visible broad plank divisions, and a few friendly painted wear marks. Keep every sail's construction legible.
Add wide wooden plank lines to the gallery deck and rail, using WOOD_LIGHT highlights and WOOD_DARK seams. The result should feel hand-built and cozy, not photorealistic.
Add a tiny warm lantern and brass weather vane on the roof peak: a faceted golden cap, a softly glowing amber lantern body, and a simple four-point arrow. Keep it compact and clear of the sails.
Add two small flower boxes beneath the upper front windows. Use WOOD_LIGHT boxes with dark soil, several chunky LEAF leaves, and pink FLOWER blossoms. Mirror the pair symmetrically.
Add a cheerful brass door handle and a small round mail slot to the teal door. Use BRASS with a bright highlight and keep both details centered on the clear door face.

Decorate each of the four sails with a pair of short cream pennant ribbons tied near the outer tip. Use SAIL and ROOF_LIGHT, with chunky triangular flags that flutter sideways but stay within the sail silhouette.
Build a richer central axle hub: a large faceted WOOD_DARK boss, a brass ring, four small radial bolts, and a tiny cream center cap. Make it the visual focal point where all four sails meet.

Place a small painted oval sign on the right side of the tower reading as a friendly mill emblem: cream signboard, dark blue windmill pictogram, and a tiny red heart. It should sit flush on the side and not interfere with the front sails.
Add a restrained ring of rounded garden stones and three tiny clumps of grass around the foot of the tower. Use STONE_DARK, LEAF, and a few FLOWER dots; keep the footprint tight to the windmill.
